project_identity.domain_and_context: Indonesian Financial & ERP SaaS Platform for Enterprises, SMBs, Accountants, and Auditors
project_identity.target_audience: CFOs, Finance Directors, Accounting Managers, Tax Consultants, Enterprise Owners, and External Auditors in Indonesia
project_identity.user_authorization: Fully authorized rebrand to lowercase zafeb, incorporation of 3D logo mark, structured marketing catalog, and interactive guided sandbox demo (Demo Mandiri dengan tur terpandu).

design_archetype.name: Swiss Organic Fintech (Dark Emerald & Warm Paper)
design_archetype.aesthetic_description: Combines institutional Swiss financial precision with organic Indonesian warmth. Utilizes deep forest emerald (#091E16, #0A2219) for authority, warm paper cream (#FDFBF7, #F5F1E8) for organic readability, vibrant emerald mint (#10B981) for growth indicators, and subtle champagne gold (#E5B869) for luxury accents.
design_archetype.emotional_goal: Unshakable trust, enterprise security, modern agility, effortless compliance with Indonesian financial standards (PSAK & Tax Laws).

rules.tinted_greys: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint all neutrals with 5-10% deep pine green or warm ochre sand.
rules.contrast_standard: All text must meet APCA contrast standards and WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against solid/glass surfaces.
rules.gradient_limit: No gradients over 20% of screen area. Use texture overlays (subtle noise/paper grain) over glossy flat gradients.
rules.cta_primary_color: #10B981 (Emerald Mint) or #091E16 (Deep Forest) with white text. Reserved strictly for primary action triggers.

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy_rules.overline_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400

typesetting.anti_default_rule: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for Headings. Heading text MUST use Cabinet Grotesk with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
typesetting.subtle_overlines: All section badges must be uppercase text-xs with tracking-[0.2em] padding.

logo_mark.name: 3D zafeb Geometric Emblem
logo_mark.wordmark_style: lowercase, bold Cabinet Grotesk, font-weight 800, tracking-tighter, dark green / emerald mint color

geometry_specs.shape_description: Interlocking 3D faceted emerald ribbon/cube forming an abstract z-shaped financial architectural prism.
geometry_specs.materials: Glassmorphic frosted emerald crystal with subtle gold inner reflection core (roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.35, transmission: 0.7).
geometry_specs.lighting: Studio three-point lighting (Key light #10B981 at top-left 45deg, Fill light #E5B869 at bottom-right, Ambient light intensity 0.6).
geometry_specs.canvas_implementation: React Three Fiber (<Canvas>) or Canvas 2D / CSS 3D fallback with subtle mouse movement inertia (-15deg to +15deg rotation).

logo_mark.header_positioning: Fixed top-left navbar inside standard header container, rendering 3D Emblem (36px x 36px) on desktop, (28px x 28px) on mobile, immediately preceding the lowercase wordmark 'zafeb'.
logo_mark.mobile_scaling: Ensure logo and text stay aligned inline without wrapping. Max height 32px on screens under 640px.

header_nav.surface_style: Crystal Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-warm_paper_light/80 dark:bg-base_dark.deep_forest/85 border-b border-emerald-900/10 dark:border-white/10 z-50 fixed top-0 left-0 right-0
header_nav.padding: px-6 py-4 max-w-7xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between

hero_section.layout_pattern: Asymmetric Tetris Grid (2-column on desktop: 7 cols main copy + 5 cols 3D preview/interactive widget)
hero_section.spacing: pt-32 pb-20 md:pt-40 md:pb-32 px-6 lg:px-12
hero_section.visual_elements: Dynamic background glowing gradient mesh in dark emerald + warm paper, kinetic scroll ticker, interactive 3D zafeb mark float.

bento_grid_protocol.padding_rule: All grid card containers MUST have at least p-6 to p-8 internal padding to eliminate text boundary clipping.

interactive_sandbox_demo_guidelines.demo_type: Demo mandiri dengan tur terpandu (Isolated fictional data sandbox with guided step-by-step tour)
interactive_sandbox_demo_guidelines.container_structure: Full-screen responsive SaaS workspace simulation embedded in landing page modal or designated /demo route.

topbar_and_sidebar.sidebar_style: Dark Pine Emerald (#05140E) with collapsible 16-module navigation icons, search bar, active entity badge ('PT Nusa Jaya Abadi - Fictional Enterprise')
topbar_and_sidebar.topbar_style: Warm Paper (#FDFBF7) top bar with period selector ('Q3 2026 / Jul 2026'), currency toggle ('IDR / USD'), sandbox reset button, and guided tour launcher ('Mulai Tur Terpandu').

guided_tour_steps.title: Selamat Datang di zafeb Sandbox
guided_tour_steps.description: Jelajahi ekosistem keuangan zafeb secara mandiri. Data ini adalah simulasi fiktif yang dapat Anda ubah dan uji secara langsung.

guided_tour_steps.description: Coba tambahkan atau edit transaksi jurnal. Anda akan melihat laporan laba rugi dan chart memperbarui secara otomatis!

guided_tour_steps.title: Analisis Berbasis AI (Simulasi)
guided_tour_steps.description: Ajukan pertanyaan analisis keuangan. Modul ini menampilkan respons presisi berbasis algoritma kecerdasan zafeb (SIMULASI).

guided_tour_steps.title: Kepatuhan Pajak Indonesia (PPh/PPn)

guided_tour_steps.title: Skenario Simulasi Anggaran
guided_tour_steps.description: Geser slider proyeksi pendapatan dan biaya untuk melihat simulasi cashflow 12 bulan ke depan.

modules_list: Financial Statements (Laba Rugi, Neraca, Arus Kas)
interactive_sandbox_demo_guidelines.ai_analyst_disclaimer: All AI analyst responses in the sandbox MUST display a clear 'SIMULASI DEMO' pill badge to reinforce that no live API credits or admin authentications are consumed.

component_design_rules.tables_and_data: Dense typography, tabular-nums class for monetary numbers, clear APCA contrast, sticky headers for long journals.

motion_and_animations.engine: Framer Motion combined with Lenis smooth scroll
motion_and_animations.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling parallax and high-frequency rotations.

data_testid_convention.rule: All interactive elements (buttons, links, module tabs, inputs, dropdowns, tour triggers) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT modify application source code during blueprint setup.
2. Ensure complete rebrand fidelity to lowercase 'zafeb' across all navigation, page content, footers, meta tags, and demo headers.
3. Implement the 3D logo mark next to 'zafeb' at top-left using the geometry and material guidance specified.
4. Preserve the warm paper and dark emerald theme with high contrast, crisp typography (Cabinet Grotesk / Satoshi / JetBrains Mono).
5. Build the full-page interactive sandbox demo with 16 modules, fictional editable transactions, live financial recalculation, and step-by-step guided tour.
6. Include all data-testid attributes on interactive components for robust test automation.
